baseline_description: Search BM25-ranked original passages. Keywords match any by default; all_terms=true requires every term. Quote multiword phrases. Global results contain distinct documents. scope filters an ID, title or source substring; set scope to an exact document ID to search its passages for a missing fact. Hits include surrounding original context, character offsets and document length; truncated means more of that document exists. Empty query lists documents; limit/offset paginate.
candidate_description: Search original passages with BM25 lexical ranking. Use a complete question or informative terms that preserve the distinguishing entities, dates, locations and conditions; overly generic keywords can retrieve a different event. Words match any by default. all_terms=true requires every term and can exclude relevant wording; quote only phrases expected verbatim. If results are off-topic, vary terminology or relax restrictive terms or scope. If results look relevant, limit/offset can expose further candidates instead of repeating similar queries. Global results contain distinct documents. scope filters an ID, title or source substring; an exact document ID searches passages within that document. Hits include original context, offsets and document length; truncated means more text is available through read. Empty query lists documents.
